purpose: Check generated PLANESURFACE callback delivery/readback and AC1027 inline-payload refusal/retry behavior in the headless 3D consumer probe.
changes: Added a runtime-authored DRW_PlaneSurface with modelerFormatVersion 3, uIsolines 5, and vIsolines 7.
Asserted PLANESURFACE entity identity, the three authored fields, and absence of an ACIS byte carrier after callback readback.
Ran both ASCII and Binary output with ext=false and legacy ext=true consumer modes.

Added AC1027 negative controls that submit an inline text ACIS payload, assert writer refusal and byte-for-byte preservation of an existing destination, then retry with corrected content using the same writer and verify LINE readback.
scopeLimit: Same-library generated DXF field/callback transport plus a writer version-policy refusal/rollback/retry check. The rejected ACIS text is synthetic and not valid geometry. No surface geometry, ACIS semantics, independent interoperability, or native rendering is established.
fixturePolicy: ASCII and Binary DXF files are generated under the existing unique temporary test directory and removed; no fixture was added.
